name: Prometheus
model: Metric time series named by labels, pulled (scraped) from your services every few seconds; PromQL queries; alerting rules
engine_note: Custom TSDB: recent samples in memory (head) plus a WAL, cut into immutable two-hour blocks on local disk, compacted into larger blocks later
consistency: No transactions; samples are appended per scrape. Local storage 'is not clustered or replicated'; a lost disk loses its data. High availability means running two identical servers that each scrape, with small differences between them.
scaling: Deliberately single node: grow the machine, split targets across servers (federation, functional sharding), or remote-write to Thanos, Mimir, Cortex or VictoriaMetrics for scale and retention.
managed: Google Cloud Managed Service for Prometheus
Azure Monitor managed service for Prometheus
version_note: 3.13.4 (2026-10-02) is a later patch on an older long-term-support line; 3.15.0 is the newest feature release.
reach: Reach for it to collect and alert on service metrics (latency, error rate, queue depth) in Kubernetes or any fleet; it is the default metrics tool.
avoid: Avoid as long-term or global storage across many clusters, for per-event data like logs, or for high-cardinality labels such as user ids.
escape: Postgres is the wrong place for scraped metrics sampled every few seconds and queried by label and time range.
chat: Service metrics: request rate, latency histograms, GPU usage and rate-limit rejections, with alerts.
notes: CLAIM CHECK (d) 'Prometheus is deliberately a single node with local storage': VERIFIED. Storage docs (https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/storage/): 'Note that a limitation of local storage is that it is not clustered or replicated. Thus, it is not arbitrarily scalable or durable in the face of drive or node outages and should be managed like any other single node database.' and 'Prometheus's local storage is limited to a single node's scalability and durability. Instead of trying to solve clustered storage in Prometheus itself, Prometheus offers a set of interfaces that allow integrating with remote storage systems.' The second quote supports 'deliberately'. Block quote: 'Ingested samples are grouped into two-hour blocks.' Compaction: 'larger blocks containing data spanning up to 10% of the retention time, or 31 days, whichever is smaller.' HA-by-duplicate-servers is standard Prometheus practice, stated from general docs, not quoted this session. Managed list is Prometheus-compatible services (not Prometheus itself); not individually re-fetched. No Jepsen analysis.
